note: The graph the LINKER builds, per target, from the object set the build DECLARES (zig build object-manifest). Distinct from the @import graph in check-module-graph.py: moving a file between directories changes that one and cannot change this one. Cycles/size/trapped are gated and must not rise, and are all this file stores. ccd/acd/nccd and the one-symbol cycle edges are printed on every run, not gated: Lakos's NCCD threshold assumes cycles cost compile time, and z47's cost neither compile time, flash (--gc-sections) nor test isolation (owners already link standalone).
